My New Friend

My name is Alice. I'm twelve years old. I'm from China, but now I live in Beijing with my family. I am a student in Class 3, Grade 7.

I have a new friend. His name is Eric. He is from the U.S.A. He is in Class 3, too. Eric is a nice boy. He likes China very much. He can speak a little Chinese, and he often helps me with my English.

Every morning, Eric goes to school by bike. He always wears a blue jacket and black pants. He likes playing basketball after school. His favorite food is dumplings. On weekends, he often plays computer games or reads books at home.

I'm happy to have a good friend like him.

reading.passage:
My New School

My name is Amy. I am an exchange (交换的) student from the UK. This is my first week at Sunshine Middle School. Let me tell you about my new school campus (校园)! The school is quite large. In the middle of the school is a beautiful garden. There are many trees, flowers, and comfortable benches where we can sit and talk. In front of the garden is the classroom building. My classroom is on the first floor, which is very convenient (方便的). Behind the garden is the huge sports field. We play football there after 4:30 p.m. On the left side of the campus, there is a dining hall. The food here is different from English food, but it tastes very good! On the right side, there is a modern building with a library on the first floor and a computer room on the second floor. I love my new school!
reading.passageCn:
我的新学校

我叫 Amy，是来自英国的交换生(exchange student)，这是我在阳光中学的第一周。校园很大：正中是一个漂亮的花园，有树、花和长椅。花园前面是教学楼，我的教室在一楼，很方便。花园后面是大操场，我们 4:30 之后在那里踢球。校园左边是餐厅，饭菜和英国的不一样但很好吃。右边是一栋现代建筑，一楼是图书馆、二楼是电脑室。我爱我的新学校！

reading.passage:
School Life in Seoul

Hello, I am Min-jun from Seoul, South Korea. School life here is very busy. I go to school by subway at 7:40 AM. We have four classes in the morning and three classes in the afternoon. My favourite subject is PE because I love playing sports with my classmates. School finishes at 4:30 PM, but my day does not end there. I go to a special evening school called a hagwon (课外补习班) to study English and maths until 8:00 PM. I finally get home around 8:30 PM and eat dinner with my parents.
reading.passageCn:
首尔的校园生活

我叫 Min-jun，来自韩国首尔。这里的校园生活很忙。我早上 7:40 坐地铁上学，上午四节课、下午三节课。我最喜欢体育，因为爱和同学一起运动。学校 4:30 放学，但我的一天还没结束——我还要去一所叫 hagwon(课外补习班)的晚间学校学英语和数学，到晚上 8:00。大约 8:30 到家，和父母一起吃晚饭。

School Rules

Every school has rules. At Green Middle School, students must wear a school uniform every day, and they have to arrive before eight o'clock. reading.passage:
The Wise Old Man

Once upon a time, there was a poor but wise old man in a small village. One day, a greedy emperor came to him and asked, 'How can I become happy?' The old man said, 'Help your people, and do not tell lies.' The emperor was angry and went away. But later, he remembered the words. He began to help the poor and treat people well. Soon, everyone in the country loved him. From that day on, the emperor was truly happy.
reading.passageCn: 很久以前，一个小村庄里住着一位贫穷却睿智的老人。一天，一个贪婪的皇帝来问他："我怎样才能快乐？"老人说："帮助你的人民，不要说谎。"皇帝很生气，走了。但后来他记起了这些话。他开始帮助穷人、善待他人。很快，全国的人都爱戴他。从那天起，皇帝真正快乐了。
